platform: Linux x86-64 AMD Strix Halo gfx1151, 128 GB unified memory

method.execution: Sequential immutable Nix releases; no concurrent build or GPU jobs during timings
method.arithmetic: FP32 activation/score arithmetic and ordered reductions retained; GGUF and cache precision unchanged
method.ties: Both signs of zero canonicalized in radix keys to match numeric score equality and lower-index tie rule
method.tokens: Hashes cover little-endian generated token IDs; stop-token IDs count toward the fixed workload
